gold_with_text_not_included.reason: Text file is a minimal extraction stub (flagged incomplete) with only one table caption; no Methods, participants, task description or Results, so criteria I1-I6 cannot be assessed. Returned to retrieval rather than excluded.

Event-related fMRI (I1) of reappraisal to increase or decrease responses (I2) to threat-related IAPS pictures (I3) in 24 healthy women (I4), with within-task regulation contrasts such as decrease-minus-view (I5). However, every reported analysis is restricted to atlas ROIs (amygdala, ACC, DLPFC, OFC) with small-volume correction; no whole-brain analysis is reported, so E2 is met and I6 is not demonstrated.

The text file is a sparse extraction record with abstract-level content only: no Methods details (acquisition parameters, model, inference settings), no tables, no coordinate space, and only a single amygdala effect paraphrasing the abstract. Whole-brain evidence (I6) and specific contrasts (I5) cannot be assessed; returning to retrieval rather than excluding.

fMRI reappraisal of IAPS images in 30 healthy adults (I1-I4 met). The only reported whole-brain analyses are across-subject correlations between reappraisal-related activation and reappraisal success, and vlPFC mediation analyses; a group-level within-task contrast such as reappraise > look, or an unregulated viewing contrast, is not reported (I5 not_met, not demonstrated).

The text file is a stub extraction record. It holds only the title, the group labels (PTSD, resilience) and a one-line task description, with no Methods, Results, analyses or tables. The criteria cannot be judged from it, so it goes back to retrieval rather than being excluded.

The text file is a sparse record lacking the Methods: no task description, stimuli, regulation instructions, acquisition parameters, sample sizes or inference/coverage details. It lists Fear > Neutral and Regulation > Perception contrasts with MNI coordinates (Table 1) plus amygdala connectivity, but I2, I3, I4 and I6 cannot be assessed from this text. Returned to retrieval rather than excluded.

Healthy adults (I4) reappraised IAPS pictures during task fMRI (I1-I3), with a Negative > Reappraise contrast (I5). The model settings describe a whole-brain Reappraise > Negative one-sample t-test with FDR correction in MNI space. However, the text reports no results for it: no coordinate tables, and the only extracted analysis is an amygdala ROI. The Results for the whole-brain analysis seem to be missing from the file, so I6 and E2 cannot be judged. Returned to retrieval rather than excluded.

Task fMRI of cognitive reappraisal (Reduce vs. Maintain) of negative IAPS images (I1-I3, I5), with whole-brain AlphaSim-corrected results in Talairach space (I6). However, the high-anxiety group is a clinical population (12 of 13 met full criteria for anxiety disorders). The only within-task contrast pools both groups (N = 26), and the other contrasts are group-by-task interactions. The control group's within-group results are not reported separately, so I4 is not met.

Reappraisal fMRI (decrease/increase/maintain) with IAPS pictures in women with BPD and healthy controls. Whole-brain MNI tables exist, but the within-task effects (negative > neutral, decrease > maintain, increase > maintain) are reported only for the pooled patient + control sample, and the rest are group interactions. Results for the control group alone are not reported, so I4 was not demonstrated. I1-I3, I5 and I6 met.

Task fMRI in 17 healthy women who viewed high-calorie food images and either admitted or down-regulated their desire to eat. The target of regulation is appetitive desire for food (craving), not an emotional response, so an emotion regulation strategy toward emotional stimuli was not shown (I2 not met). For the same reason, the REGULATE vs ADMIT contrasts are regulation of desire rather than of emotion (I5 not met). The whole-brain MNI results in Table 1 would otherwise satisfy I6.

Cognitive reappraisal task (Up/Down/Maintain) in BPD, trauma-exposed non-PTSD and healthy women. Only between-group differences for Up vs Maintain and Down vs Maintain are reported (Table 2), so E4 is met and no within-group control results exist (I4, I5 not demonstrated). Stimulus modality and whole-brain coordinates are not described (I3, I6 not demonstrated).

Task fMRI in 24 healthy women; disengage/engage via cognitive reappraisal toward victims in pictures (I1-I5 met; E5 not met because participants regulate their own affect). However, every reported analysis is restricted to AAL anatomical ROIs with ROI-scoped correction; no whole-brain voxelwise map with peak coordinates is demonstrated (I6 not met, E2 met).

IAPS reappraisal and distraction task in remitted MDD patients and healthy controls; I1-I4 met. All reported results are anatomical ROI analyses (amygdala, OFC, dmPFC) with FWE correction inside the ROIs, and no whole-brain map (E2 met, I6 not met). The reported effects are only patient-vs-control comparisons. Within-group results are not reported (E4 met).

fMRI reappraise-versus-attend task with negative and neutral IAPS pictures in 58 healthy adults (I1-I5 met). Every reported analysis is restricted to atlas ROIs (DLPFC, lateral OFC, amygdala) with ROI-level FWE correction, and no whole-brain map is reported (E2 met, I6 not met).

Task fMRI in which participants reappraise IAPS pictures (I1-I3), with a healthy control group (I4). The only analysis reported is a seed-based PPI (subgenual cingulate seed) comparing the two cocaine groups during Maintain>Observe. The text reports no whole-brain task activation map (I6 not demonstrated, E3 met) and no within-group effect (E4 met). I5 is therefore not demonstrated as an activation contrast.

Reappraisal task (Decrease vs Look on negative images) in 157 community volunteers (I1-I5 met). The only reported analysis relates extracted dorsal ACC ROI responses to atherosclerosis and IL-6 through mediation. No whole-brain voxelwise map with peak coordinates is shown (I6 not met, E2 met).

Task fMRI in 19 healthy children (I1, I4) using positive cognitive reappraisal of sad IAPS/in-house photos (I2, I3), with whole-brain reappraise sad > view sad and sad > neutral contrasts (I5). However, the text never states that peak coordinates are reported in a standard anatomical space (no MNI/Talairach or normalization template mentioned anywhere), so I6 was not demonstrated and is recorded as not_met.

Task fMRI of reappraisal and selective attention during film clips in younger and older adults (I1-I5 met). All reported analyses are restricted to an explicit amygdala-PFC mask, with ROI-scope AlphaSim correction, and there is no whole-brain analysis. So E2 is met and whole-brain evidence is not shown (I6 not met).

Task fMRI with psychological distancing reappraisal of IAPS social images (I1-I3 met) in avoidant personality disorder patients and healthy controls. All reported analyses are avoidant vs healthy group differences (reappraisal anticipation and reactivity), with no separate control-group or within-group task maps (E4 met; I4, I5, I6 not demonstrated).

Task fMRI with instructed acceptance and reappraisal of sad pictures (I1-I3 met); control group reported separately (I4 met); within-group accept > view and reappraise > accept contrasts (I5 met). However, the group analyses were restricted by an a priori search-volume mask covering only the frontal lobes and bilateral amygdala, so no true whole-brain voxelwise map is reported (partial coverage: E2 met, I6 not demonstrated). All reported peaks lie within the mask regions.

Healthy adults reappraised IAPS negative images as a detached observer vs look (I1-I5 met). Every reported analysis concerns a right amygdala cluster (spatial scope ROI); no whole-brain voxelwise map with peak coordinates in standard space was demonstrated in the text (I6 not met). Whether a whole-brain analysis existed is not stated (E2 unclear).

Distancing vs attend during aversive IAPS pictures in healthy women (I2, I3 met). The only reported analysis is a gPPI connectivity analysis (vlPFC seed to VTA ROI). A Distance > Attend activation contrast is referenced only as the source of the seed, with no activation map or peak coordinates reported, so I5 and I6 were not demonstrated.

Panic disorder patients and healthy controls reappraising vs maintaining to negative IAPS images (I1-I3). Whole-brain Reappraisal > Maintain contrast with MNI peaks (I5, I6), but it is a main effect pooled across patients and controls; remaining analyses are between-group. Control group results are not reported separately, so the clinical-sample requirement of I4 is not demonstrated (I4 not met).

Positive and minimizing reappraisal of IAPS aversive images in healthy adults (I2, I3 met). The only reported analysis is an ROI-based, small-volume-corrected PPI connectivity result between vmPFC and amygdala. There is no whole-brain activation map with coordinates (I6 not met, E2 and E3 met).
